description: Changes the geometry of the bridge in the open model in place, with the Bridge Reshaper plugin's own engine (1.0.6): new span lengths (the deck is stretched - each span keeps its element count), a skew for each support, a new horizontal alignment (straight, segments, fitted points, LandXML/DXF) and new deck levels (flat, grades with parabolic vertical curves, one-way or crowned cross slope). crossMembers 'parallel' (default) moves nodes only - every element, node, load, group, stage and lane keeps its id; 'square' re-meshes the deck with cross members square to the girders running on to the skewed support lines (straight decks of beam girders only, not with new levels). Loads, structure groups, construction stages, lanes, tapered groups and links follow the deck; beam loads in global axes, plane loads and lane end skews are turned with it; piers and abutments follow their supports ('follow' the skew, or 'rigid' keep their shape). Previews by default: the changes, the issues and a plan drawing (grey = as it is, blue = proposed), with a planHash; nothing is written. With apply: true and confirmPlanHash it re-reads the model, refuses if anything changed since the preview, writes, reads every written node and element back, and records the run for bridge_reshape_undo. Lengths and chainages in the model's unit. Use bridge_reshape_read first. Runs as a background job on the website (poll job_status).

addToEverySpan.description: Instead of spans: add this to every span.

alignment.description: A new horizontal alignment (default: as modelled - a curved deck keeps its curve). straight: a straight line through the deck start, at the deck's start heading or headingDeg (straightens a curved deck). segments: straights, arcs and clothoid transitions from the deck start, along the deck. points: a curve fitted to X,Y points (model coordinates unless keepCoordinates: false): spline through them, or a least-squares arc or polynomial. landxml / dxf: the file's text. The deck line that follows it is the centreline unless followLine names a girder/edge line (index from bridge_reshape_read).

chStart.description: Chainage along the alignment where the deck starts. Default: just far enough that a skewed deck start lies on it.

headingDeg.description: straight: plan direction in degrees from global X (anticlockwise).

index.description: landxml / dxf: which alignment in the file (default 0).

keepCoordinates.description: points / landxml / dxf: use the coordinates as given (true) or place the curve's start at the deck start along the deck (false).

radius.description: arc: radius; spiral: radius at its start (omit = from straight).

radiusEnd.description: spiral: radius at its end (omit = to straight).

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview (and saved a copy of the model).

axis.description: Spans run along global X or Y. Default: X, or Y when no deck is found along X (the read says which it used).

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

deckGroups.description: Structure groups that ARE the deck, when the automatic choice is wrong. Default: found from the model.

layout.description: Deck in straight pieces only: straight (lay it straight) or turns at joints, piers or chainages, each with its angle in degrees (positive turns left).

square.description: Cross members follow the supports (square grid when all supports are square).

levels.description: New deck levels (default: as modelled). Each node keeps its depth below the deck surface; piers and abutments are stretched vertically to meet the deck (their lowest node stays).

pct.description: oneway: rising to the left, % (negative falls); crown: falling each way from the centreline, %.

g0.description: grades: grade from Abutment A, in %. Default: the deck's average grade now.

pvis.description: grades: intersection points by NEW chainage from Abutment A.

z0.description: Level at Abutment A (flat: the level everywhere). Default: as modelled.

picture.description: Return a plan drawing (PNG) to look at.

skewAll.description: Instead of skews: the same skew at every support.

skews.description: New skew of every support in degrees from square, Abutment A first; null keeps one. Default: as modelled.

spans.description: New length of every span, Abutment A first (model unit). Default: as modelled.

substructure.description: follow: piers and abutments shear with their support's skew; rigid: they keep their shape and turn with it.

supports.description: Where the supports are, chosen instead of the ones found — when the plugin finds none (bearings it cannot read) or finds every construction-stage support defined. Each: ch = chainage along the deck from where its girders start (model unit), skew in degrees from square. At least the two ends. bridge_reshape_read reports the girders' extent and the supports it found.

name: bridge_reshape
title: Bridge Reshaper — change spans, skews, alignment and levels
